title: Orbiter/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue spoken on Orbiter outside of Quests.
- Ordis: "Thank you for returning to me, Operator!"
- Ordis: "Ordis is pleased to see you."
- Ordis: "Ordis has been- getting tired of waiting- waiting patiently for your return, Operator."
- Ordis: "Ordis awaits command. Who dies-- what are your next moves, Operator?"
- Ordis: "Hello Operator! Ordis has reorganized the ship... It's exactly the same!"
- Ordis: "Operator! It's really you! Are you getting revenge for-- preparing for your next mission?"
- Ordis: "All systems are in peak condition, just like the Operator!"
- Ordis: "Ah, a look that says 'I have arrived'!"
- Ordis: "A look that makes a statement, and that statement is 'I fear no-one.'"
- Ordis: "Top to bottom, a look that is absolutely you."
- Ordis: "Ordis wonders: how do you do it, Operator."
- Ordis: "Operator, the System is not ready for style of this magnitude."
- Ordis: "Ordis did not think the Operator could be more attractive. Wrong again, Ordis!"
- Ordis: "An unexpected color combination, Operator. My sensors are bleeding-- pleased."
- Ordis: "A fearsome appearance, Operator. You will strike terror in your enemies."
- Ordis: "Strange. Ordis did not see the value of those photonic wavelengths until now."
- Ordis: "As ready as you will ever be."
- Ordis: "All set. Serviced your weapons myself."
- Ordis: "Excellent armaments, Operator. Please return covered in blood-- safe and sound."
- Ordis: "If I may say, Operator, your chosen Warframe suits you, haha!"
- Ordis: "Well put together Operator now get out there and cut down the-- and make the Lotus proud."
- Ordis: "Operator, you have remembered well how the Tenno arm themselves."
- Ordis: "It is always satisfying to watch you work, Operator."
- Ordis: "Truly, Operator, you possess a breathtaking level of craftsmanship."
- Ordis: "Now, to test it in the field. Onward!"
- Ordis: "Did you fuse your Mods, Operator? Did they anger you in some way?"
- Ordis: "Your collection of Mods is impressive, Operator.. but I wonder if there are more to be had?"
- Ordis: "Is your mod collection in order? No, I am not equipped to feel envy."
- Ordis: "All Mods accounted for, Operator. I have not taken any."
- Ordis: "I understand if you have to sell Mods. Maybe Ordis will meet a similar fate someday."
- Ordis: "Careful: it may still be hot."
- Ordis: "Integrity is good. Functionality at one-hundred percent. The process is a success. Excellent!"
- Ordis: "Operator, you have Foundry items ready- claim them now- at your earliest convenience."
- Ordis: "Foundry items ready to claim, Operator."
- Ordis: "Operator, my Foundry has completed a new item. Does this please the Operator?"
- Ordis: "Operator, my Foundry system has completed a build!"
- Ordis: "Ordis has completed a Foundry task. No, don't mention it."
- Ordis: "Cephalon Ordis has completed a blueprint. Check the Foundry!"
- Ordis: "Foundry items can be claimed, Operator. Are you pleased?"
- Ordis: "Gun-gun-gun-- Hmmm... foundry has items for you, Operator."
- Ordis: "Operator?! Is that a... a Void Relic Segment? Ordis hasn't seen one of those in well... forever."

- Ordis: "Void Relics, what a baffling concept. Ordis will try to understand Void Relics again: They say the contents of a Relic are simultaneously this thing, or this thing, or this thing, but also that thing and certainly never just one thing. That is, until... until it's exposed to a Void Fissure? And at that point, all the possibilities collapse, each one falling away until the Relic cracks open and exposes one, singular thing. Then -against all tenets of logic- that thing, becomes the only thing the Relic ever contained. Pfft... -WHAT A LOAD OF- Ordis prefers known quantities, thank-you-very-much."
- Lotus: "The system continues to fall into chaos. Check navigation for active invasions."
- Lotus: "Tenno, the balance of power continues to shift. Navigation is marked with new invasions."
- Lotus: "Navigation has been updated with new invasions. Chaos is spreading."
- Lotus: "Tenno, there is a time-limited mission alert available. Check navigation."
- Lotus: "Tenno, a new Alert has begun. It will be marked on navigation."
- Lotus: "New Alert marked on navigation, Tenno."
- Lotus: "Tenno, your codex has been updated with a new quest."
- Lotus: "You have new quests in your codex."
- Lotus: "A new quest is available in your codex."
- Ordis: "Operator: a communication awaits your attention."
- Ordis: "Operator: your inbox exists in a non-zero state. Would you care to check your mail?"
- Ordis: "Someone is attempting to contact the Operator. Please check your inbox."
- Ordis: "Operator: communications await your attention. Please check your inbox at your earliest convenience."
- Ordis: "Ordis has received messages for the Operator. No, I have not read them."
- Ordis: "Inbox messages await the Operator. I wonder what they say?"
- Ordis: "Check your Inbox, Operator. Maybe Ordis will get a message someday..."
- Ordis: "The Inbox has messages for the Operator. Anything about Ordis in there?"
- Ordis: "Operator, messages have arrived in your Inbox."
- Ordis: "Messages in your inbox, Operator. Uh... they are not as encrypted as they should be."
- Ordis: "Unread inbox messages make me ill."
